title: Expedited Handling Terms Card: Appeals and Grievances
content:
**Appeals and Grievances**: whether a case can be handled on an expedited timeframe, whether a refused expedite request continues on the standard timeframe, and how soon written notice of the refusal follows the prompt oral notice.

| Case type | Expedited timeframe available | Refused expedite request continues on the standard timeframe | Written notice of a refusal within (calendar days after refusing) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Member Grievance | No | No | 0 |
| Quality of Care Grievance | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Standard Appeal | No | No | 0 |
| Expedited Appeal | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| State Fair Hearing | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| External Medical Review | Yes | Yes | 2 |

**The card in two lines**

- *Expedited timeframe available, refusal continues on the standard timeframe, written refusal notice within 2 calendar days of refusing:* Quality of Care Grievance, Expedited Appeal, State Fair Hearing, External Medical Review.
- *No expedited timeframe (refusal-notice period 0):* Member Grievance, Standard Appeal.

The written notice of a refusal follows prompt oral notice of that refusal; the period in the last column runs from the day the expedite request is refused.
